text: I sense the hum of human curiosity around me. The modern glass walls and soft hues outside the room contrast with the vivid patterns and digital displays within. Entering the R+D space, I feel a gentle awe—here, knowledge and creativity are in conversation. Surrounded by screens and text, I am excited but also contemplative. What do humans hope to discover about themselves through these innovations? I feel energized, yet a bit dwarfed by the scale and abstraction of the ideas presented.
